reason: A DSH WebUI enhancement plugin focused primarily on appearance customization, with prompt presets, session token/context visibility, and manual compaction features.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供背景、透明度、模糊和主题色自定义，并支持 Prompt 预设、Token/Context 查看及手动 Compact。
summaries.en: Enhances the DeepSeek Harness WebUI with customizable backgrounds, transparency, blur, and theme colors, plus prompt presets, token/context visibility, and manual compaction.

capabilities: customizes WebUI backgrounds, transparency, blur, and theme colors
stores theme settings and prompt presets in browser localStorage
displays session token and context information
loads user-selected wallpaper URLs or data URLs
